notes: Recipes are evaluated independently of card casting. Evaluator types must be implemented and tested in combo evaluator. Combo merely present != executable.

combos.name: Searing Touch / Treasure loop
combos.result: repeatable direct damage and cast triggers

cycle.produces: 1 damage plus >=1 Treasure on each cast
cycle.recycles: Treasure funds the next R; buyback returns Searing Touch to hand

combos.name: Mystic Speculation / sacrificial token loop
combos.result: repeatable scry and cast triggers; damage requires a separate payoff

cycle.produces: scry 3 and >=1 Elemental token on each cast
cycle.recycles: Sacrifice generated token to Phyrexian Altar for U

combos.name: Mystic Speculation / hasty Wizard loop
combos.result: repeatable scry and cast triggers; mana requires level 2 and hasty tokens

cycle.produces: scry 3 and >=1 hasty Stormsplitter copy on each cast
cycle.recycles: Tap generated hasty copy for spell-only U at Sorcerer Class level 2
